question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Eloquent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impotent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eloquent **means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing. (बोलने या लिखने में धाराप्रवाह या प्रेरक)

 
 
• **For example**: *Her eloquent speech captivated the audience's attention.*
 
 
 
• **Impotent **means powerless or ineffective. (शक्तिहीन या अप्रभावी)
 
 
• **For example**: *His arguments were impotent in persuading anyone to change their minds.*
 
 
 
• The two words are antonyms as they have opposite meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modest **means unassuming or moderate in opinion or estimate of one's abilities. (किसी की क्षमताओं के बारे में राय या अनुमान में विनम्र या उदारवादी)
 
• **Crucial **means decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something. (निर्णायक या आलोचनात्मक, विशेषकर किसी चीज़ की सफलता या विफलता में)
 
• **Humble **means having a modest or low view of one's importance. (किसी के महत्व के प्रति विनम्र या निम्न दृष्टिकोण रखना)
